entries.title: Job 27:1
segments: And Job continued the lifting up of His speech, and said,

entries.title: Job 27:2
segments: [As] God lives, He has taken away my judgment; and the Almighty has made my soul bitter.

entries.title: Job 27:3
segments: As long as my breath [is] in me, and the spirit of God [is] in my nostrils,

entries.title: Job 27:4
segments: my lips shall not speak wickedness, nor my tongue utter deceit.

entries.title: Job 27:5
segments: Far be it from me that I should justify you; until I die I will not retract my integrity from me.

entries.title: Job 27:6
segments: I hold fast by my righteousness, and I will not let it go; my heart shall not shame me [any] of my days.

entries.title: Job 27:7
segments: Let my enemy be like the wicked, and he who rises up against me as the perverse.

entries.title: Job 27:8
segments: For what [is] the hope of the ungodly when He cuts off, when God takes away his soul?

entries.title: Job 27:9
segments: Will God hear his cry when trouble comes on him?

entries.title: Job 27:10
segments: Will he delight himself in the Almighty? Will he always call on God?

entries.title: Job 27:11
segments: I will teach you by the hand of God; that which [is] with the Almighty I will not hide.

entries.title: Job 27:12
segments: Behold, all you have seen [it] yourselves; why then do you become completely vain?

entries.title: Job 27:13
segments: This [is] the portion of a wicked man with God, and the inheritance of cruel men [which] they shall receive from the Almighty.

entries.title: Job 27:14
segments: If his sons are multiplied, [the] sword [is] for them; and his offspring shall not be satisfied with bread.

entries.title: Job 27:15
segments: Those who remain of him shall be buried in death; and his widows shall not weep.

entries.title: Job 27:16
segments: Though he heaps up silver like the dust, and prepares clothing like the clay,

entries.title: Job 27:17
segments: he may prepare, but the just shall put [it] on, and the innocent shall divide the silver.

entries.title: Job 27:18
segments: He builds his house like a moth, and like a booth [that] a watchman makes.

entries.title: Job 27:19
segments: The rich man shall lie down, but he shall not be gathered. He opens his eyes, and he [is] not.

entries.title: Job 27:20
segments: Terrors overtake him like waters; a tempest steals him away in the night.

entries.title: Job 27:21
segments: The east wind lifts him up, and he is gone; for it whirls him out of his place.

entries.title: Job 27:22
segments: For it will hurl at him, and will not spare; he will surely flee out of its hand.

entries.title: Job 27:23
segments: He shall clap His hands at him, and shall hiss him out of his place.
